_comment: Master portfolio config. Edit manually or use epf_sms_parser.py to update EPF section.

epf._comment: Updated from EPFO SMS. Run epf_sms_parser.py to refresh balance/last_contribution.
epf._split_comment: Confirmed by member: employee = 50% of total contribution, employer = 50%.
epf._growth_comment: contribution_step_up_pct = annual % increase in monthly contribution (salary increments).
epf._rate_comment: EPF interest rate. Check https://www.epfindia.gov.in for annual revision.
epf._tax_comment: Employee contributions above Rs 2.5L/year: interest on excess is taxable at slab rate.

sip_step_up._comment: Annual increment applied to all SIP amounts at the start of each financial year.

bonus._comment: Annual lump-sum investment (typically April/May each year).
